delete_account.title: Delete Account

warn_box.text:
If you delete your account, it will be permanently removed along with all your settings. Tasks you created will be retained, but will no longer be linked to your name. Announcements will also be retained. If you want to remove tasks or announcements, please delete them manually before deleting your account.

You can create a new account at any time, but previously added content will no longer be linked to your account, so you can no longer edit or delete it.
warn_box.title: Permanently delete your account?
